approved.en: Russian drone attacks continue, killing 13 people at a Ukrainian railway station and prompting further strikes on transport hubs. A localized cease-fire in the occupied city of Oleshky entered its third day, allowing evacuees to cross into Ukraine via Belarus and reunite with families, while attacks on aid vehicles persist. Russia’s shadow fleet is adapting drones with makeshift armor made from nets and rubber tires. Ukrainian clergy have suffered heavy losses, with 120 members reported killed. The conflict still accounts for 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russiske droneangrep fortsetter, og 13 personer ble drept på en ukrainsk jernbanestasjon, noe som førte til ytterligere angrep på transportknutepunkter. En lokalisert våpenhvile i den okkuperte byen Oleshky har nå gått inn i sin tredje dag, og gjør det mulig for evakuerte å krysse inn i Ukraina via Hviterussland og gjenforenes med familier, mens angrep på hjelpeskjøretøy vedvarer. Russlands skyggeflåte tilpasser droner med improvisert rustning laget av nett og gummidekk. Ukrainsk geistlighet har lidd store tap, med 120 medlemmer rapportert drept. Konflikten står fortsatt for 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces continue air strikes across Gaza, killing multiple civilians including children, while hospitals report severe staff trauma and bereavement. In the West Bank, Israeli settlers attacked a Palestinian town, wounding three olive harvesters and prompting a mother to live in fear of her son’s killer, while a settler council head shapes policy in the area. The UN rights office warns that displacement in Gaza is deepening into a nightmare and calls for an urgent UN protection force. Gaza doctors are struggling with overwork and trauma amid the ongoing war. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

På Vestbredden angrep israelske bosettere en palestinsk by, såret tre olivenplukkere og fikk en mor til å leve i frykt for sin sønns drapsmann, mens lederen for en bosetterråd former politikken i området. FN-s rettskontor advarer om at fordrivelsen i Gaza utvikler seg til et mareritt og etterlyser en umiddelbar FN-beskyttelsesstyrke. Gaza-leger er overarbeidet og traumatiserte i den pågående krigen. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah continues to launch rockets and artillery at Israeli positions in southern Lebanon while Israel carries out air strikes on Hezbollah sites, causing civilian casualties. Israel reported a controlled detonation of a strike in southern Lebanon, and Lebanese military courts have charged 13 individuals over a seized Hezbollah explosives truck. Lebanon has charged 13 people for confiscated Hezbollah explosives, reflecting heightened security actions. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon, and Qatar has pledged reconstruction funding for the south. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iran’s supreme leader orders the military to expand retaliation plans without geographic limits and Iran’s security chief debates discarding the nuclear weapons ban. Iranian envoys meet Qatari mediators as the United States threatens strikes after the midterms, and Iran’s strikes on U.S. Middle East bases are found to have disabled early-warning systems. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces have intensified cross-border strikes, launching drones toward Mecca that Saudi air defenses intercepted and targeting Saudi airports, including Aden where missiles hit the airport and presidential palace. In Yemen, fighting around Taiz and in Aden has displaced 290,000 people, including pregnant women, and Saudi air strikes have killed civilians in a residential area. The Houthis are also reported to be using Russian satellites to coordinate attacks. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Jemen har kamper rundt Taiz og i Aden fordrevet 290 000 personer, inkludert gravide kvinner, og saudiske luftangrep har drept sivile i et boligområde. Det rapporteres også at houthiene bruker russiske satellitter for å koordinere angrep. Konflikten forårsaket 918 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: RSF forces have launched drone strikes on a market in Darfur, killing over 100 civilians and damaging a power station that cut electricity to two states. The Sudanese army is accused of carrying out 162 drone attacks from Ethiopian territory, a claim Ethiopia denies. A senior RSF commander defected from Hemedti's forces, accusing the group’s leadership of nepotism, and an investigation has mapped RSF commanders linked to wartime rape. The UAE federal court sentenced eight people to life imprisonment for illegal arms supplies to Sudan’s army. There were 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den sudanske hæren blir anklaget for å ha utført 162 droneangrep fra etiopisk territorium, en påstand Etiopia benekter. En høytstående RSF-kommandør har gått over til side fra Hemedti-styrkene og anklager ledelsen for nepotisme, og en etterforskning har kartlagt RSF-kommandører knyttet til krigs­voldtekt. In Abyei, a market was hit by a drone strike that killed 73 people, and another drone attack in the disputed region killed 153, according to officials. The UCDP recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP. UN Secretary-General Guterres condemned the escalation of drone attacks, and the deputy minister of ICT warned against abusing freedom of expression.

approved.en: Al-Shabaab continues assaults on Somali army positions in Lower Shabelle, killing a former al-Shabaab finance chief and adding to army casualties, while Somali forces have recaptured roughly half of territory previously held by al-Shabaab and ISIS. Uganda has begun pulling its troops after two decades and the African Union is withdrawing forces from four bases in Lower Shabelle, while Ethiopia is pulling more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as fighting intensifies at home. The UAE carried out its first drone strike against al-Shabaab in nearly a year. Somali pirates seized an Iranian fishing vessel and seven Pakistani crew members were rescued after a hijacking. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Uganda har begynt å trekke tilbake troppene etter to tiår, og Den afrikanske unionen trekker styrker fra fire baser i Nedre Shabelle, mens Etiopia trekker mer enn 3 000 soldater fra Somalia etter at kampene intensiveres hjemme. De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte sitt første droneram mot Al-Shabaab på nesten ett år. Somaliske pirater kapret et iransk fiskefartøy, og syv pakistanske mannskap ble reddet etter kapringen. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
